title: Email: Owner's Rep Demands Answers, 11:10

fields.subject: RE: Ninth Street — need answers now
fields.body:
EXERCISE

Daniel Peretz,

Our PIO, Teresa Whitcomb, just saw your trench on Channel 9, and I have had no update from Larkspur since your first call. I emailed you at 10:37 and have heard nothing back. The video says "sewer workers buried," and the District's name is on the project sign right behind the fire truck.

I need three things in the next 15 minutes:

1. What happened and how many people are hurt.
2. Your confirmation that nothing goes out naming the District without our approval. That covers statements, interviews and posts.
3. Whether you will be back digging at 16+00 by Friday. Yes or no.

My Board chair is going to call me within the hour, and I am not finding out the rest from a helicopter.

Call me.
fields.signature:
Joseph Albrecht
Owner's Representative, Stillwater Creek Interceptor
Stillwater Regional Sewer District
937-555-0150

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the PM phones the owner's representative now to meet the 1-hour owner call, gives only verified facts and has the call time logged. He should commit to written notice within 24 hours and a report within 5 working days, and he should not promise a Friday restart, because restart depends on the Safety Director and the EOR. The PE should agree that the District's PIO approves any statement that names the District.
